title: Technical Recruiter for Defence & Mfg. Company
description:
**Department:** HR  
**Industry:** Defence, Manufacturing  
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About BDIL**

**Bharati Defence \& Infrastructure Limited (BDIL)** is one of India's emerging defence technology and system integration organizations, delivering advanced communication, surveillance, and mission\-critical solutions across Air, Land, and Marine platforms.

**BDIL** is now firmly aligned with the **Government of India’s Atmanirbhar Bharat and Make in India vision**, aspiring to play a leading role in **indigenous defence manufacturing, shipbuilding, and allied infrastructure projects**

**Job Summary**

BDIL is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Technical Recruiter with an engineering background who can manage end\-to\-end hiring for technical roles. Who will primarily recruit EXTC (Electronics \& Telecommunication) and IT, software, and AI/ML positions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the full recruitment cycle, from requirement gathering and sourcing to screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and onboarding.
* Work with hiring managers to understand technical requirements and create accurate job descriptions.
* Source candidates for roles in electronics, telecommunications, embedded systems, RF, networking, VLSI, IoT, and hardware design.
* Use job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.), Boolean search, social media, referrals to build strong talent pipelines.
* Conduct initial technical and HR screening to check candidates' skills, experience, and cultural fit.
* Schedule and coordinate technical interview round with hiring manager and candidates.
* Negotiate salaries, roll out offers, and manage candidates through joining to reduce drop\-offs.
* Maintain recruitment data in the trackers, and share regular hiring reports and metrics (time\-to\-hire, offer\-to\-join ratio, etc.).
* Build relationships with engineering colleges and universities for campus and fresher hiring.

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B. Tech in Electronics \& Telecommunication (EXTC), Electronics, Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering field (**mandatory**).
* 2–4 years of experience in technical recruitment, in company and startups.

**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of electronics, telecom, and software/AI technologies and job roles.
* Strong sourcing skills, including Boolean search and headhunting.
* Hands\-on experience with job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, and ATS tools.
* Ability to handle multiple positions and meet hiring deadlines.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets for reporting.

**Good to Have**

* Experience hiring for core electronics, telecom, semiconductor, or product companies.
* Exposure to AI/ML, data science, or niche tech hiring.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and performance incentives
* Opportunity to work with technical teams across electronics, IT, and AI
* Learning and career growth in talent acquisition

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your residing location?
* What is your current salary?
* what is your expected salary?
* What is your joining period?

Work Location: In person

title: Compensation Benefits Manager
description:
Job description:

CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. For this critical role, we are looking for the candidate to be based in Mumbai. You may choose to work from home in Mumbai; however, you will be required to frequently travel to our Andheri East office for business requirements, meetings, or company/team events.
We are looking for a passionate HR professional with advanced Excel skills, excellent comprehension and strong analytical depth — ideally with a background in Compensation \& Benefits or a COE analytics role — to join us as Manager, Compensation \& Benefits!
As a Manager, Compensation \& Benefits, you will be the custodian of HR data. This is an individual contributor and hands on role. You will own the gathering, cleaning, collating and converting of data into accurate reports and dashboards for leaders and stakeholders within the organization, and go beyond reporting to independently analyse the data and deliver insight leaders can act on. You will play a pivotal role as the reports, dashboards and analysis you own will enable leaders to make informed \& data\-driven decisions that will shape the future of Human Resources at CACTUS! You will report to the AVP, HR Operations \& Administration.
Job responsibilities:
* Partner with stakeholders to understand the problem statement or objective, and independently shape the right analytical approach.
* Gather relevant data from various sources, databases, internal systems and combine data from multiple sources into a cohesive dataset using MS Excel.
* Bring compensation \& benefits context to HR analytics — support people cost, salary benchmarking and compensation revision cycle analysis with market and structural context from your COE background.
* Ask the right questions, comprehend and use advanced Excel techniques such as pivots, validation automation, formulas, macros among others to analyze \& interpret the data — going beyond the numbers to explain the 'why' behind the trends.
* Own the creation and continuous improvement of various reports and dashboards such as headcount \& attrition report, people cost reports, hiring \& ad\-hoc data reports etc.
* Independently draw meaningful conclusions from the analysis, summarize key insights \& recommendations, and partner with the AVP, HR Operations \& Administration to present these to leaders and stakeholders.


Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Bachelors in any discipline; bachelor's in engineering or mathematics, statistics is preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in using advanced Excel techniques.
* Passionate about data with an affinity for numbers and metrics.
* 5–7 years of experience creating reports from scratch and analyzing HR\-related data, with prior experience in a Compensation \& Benefits function or COE strongly preferred.
* Excellent comprehension skills \& ability to ask the right questions, with a demonstrated track record of turning analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication skills, with experience presenting insights confidently to leadership and stakeholders.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, you will have to work on an assessment followed by a virtual interview and lastly an in\-person interview at our Andheri East office.

**Equal Opportunity**


Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

**Accelerating from Anywhere**


As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


About Us:

Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

**\#LIHybrid**

==============

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.


Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

**Location:** Navi Mumbai  
**Experience:** 3–6 years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Industry:** Healthcare / HealthTech / Medical Technology

About the Role

We are looking for a hands\-on **Healthcare HR \& Talent Acquisition Executive** who can independently manage recruitment and day\-to\-day HR activities for a growing healthcare technology company.

The role will involve hiring and managing talent across **Radiology, Healthcare Operations, Technology and Corporate functions**, with a strong focus on hiring **Radiologists and Radiographers**.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment and independently handling recruitment from sourcing to joining, along with regular HR operations.

Key Responsibilities1\. Healthcare \& Clinical Recruitment

* Source and recruit **Radiologists** for teleradiology operations.
* Recruit **Radiographers / Radiology Technicians**.
* Build and maintain an active database of radiologists and healthcare professionals.
* Coordinate with radiologists regarding availability, shifts, remuneration and onboarding.
* Verify professional credentials, qualifications and relevant documents.
* Coordinate interviews, discussions and negotiations.
* Ensure timely joining and onboarding of selected candidates.
* Maintain a pipeline for urgent and future clinical requirements.

2\. Technology \& Other Recruitment

Manage recruitment for:

* Software Support Engineers
* Technical Support / Implementation Engineers
* Software Developers, when required
* Sales \& Business Development
* Operations and Customer Support
* Administration and other corporate positions

Responsibilities include job posting, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, salary negotiation, offer release and joining follow\-up.

3\. HR Operations

* Employee onboarding and documentation
* Maintain employee records and HR database
* Attendance and leave management
* Payroll coordination
* Employee confirmation and appraisal processes
* Employee grievance and query handling
* Exit formalities and full \& final coordination
* HR policy implementation
* Employee engagement activities
* Preparation of monthly HR MIS

4\. Compliance \& Documentation

* Maintain complete and updated employee documentation.
* Coordinate PF, ESIC, Professional Tax and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Ensure required documentation for clinical professionals is properly maintained.
* Coordinate with external consultants/payroll vendors wherever required.

5\. HR Reporting

Prepare regular reports covering:

* Open positions
* Recruitment pipeline
* Interviews conducted
* Offers released
* Joining status
* Recruitment TAT
* Employee attrition
* Attendance
* Leave
* HR expenses
* Other HR metrics

Key RequirementsMandatory

* 3–6 years of HR experience.
* Strong experience in **Talent Acquisition / Recruitment**.
* Prior experience hiring **doctors, radiologists, radiographers, technicians or other healthcare professionals**.
* Good understanding of general HR operations.
* Excellent communication and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple vacancies.
* Good working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets.
* Experience with Naukri, LinkedIn and other recruitment platforms.

Preferred

* Experience in a hospital, diagnostic centre, teleradiology company, HealthTech or MedTech company.
* Experience hiring software/technical support personnel.
* MBA/PGDM in HR.
* Experience with HRMS/payroll systems.
* Familiarity with healthcare professional credential verification.

Key Competencies

* Strong sourcing and networking ability
* Excellent candidate communication
* Strong follow\-up discipline
* Negotiation skills
* Ownership and accountability
* Good documentation skills
* Ability to work independently
* Ability to handle confidential employee information
* Ability to work in a fast\-growing environment

What Success Looks Like

The person should be able to independently manage the complete recruitment cycle:

**Requirement → Job Posting → Sourcing → Screening → Interview → Selection → Negotiation → Offer → Joining → Onboarding**

At the same time, the person should be able to manage routine HR activities without requiring day\-to\-day supervision.

Suggested Performance Metrics

* Critical vacancy closure TAT
* Number of qualified candidates added to pipeline
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio
* 3/6\-month employee retention
* Radiologist recruitment turnaround time
* Radiographer recruitment turnaround time
* Technical recruitment turnaround time
* HR documentation completeness
* Payroll/attendance accuracy
* Employee query resolution TAT

Reporting

title: Sr. IT Recruiter
description:
REQUIREMENT SUMMARY

The Talent Acquisition Specialist plays a crucial role in our ITES sector, focusing specifically on acquiring top IT and technology talent. Working from either Bangalore or Mumbai, this position demands a strategic approach to sourcing and managing candidates, ensuring the alignment of recruitment strategies with organizational goals.

Description

\- Minimum 2\-5 years of experience in talent acquisition with a focus on IT/Technology recruitment.  
\- Strong understanding of technology skills and the ability to interpret IT job descriptions effectively.  
\- Proven hands\-on experience with sourcing platforms such as Naukri and LinkedIn.  
\- Excellent candidate screening, communication, and negotiation skills.  
\- Ability to manage multiple recruitment processes simultaneously while maintaining a focus on quality and timelines.  
\- Demonstrated ability to meet recruitment targets in a fast\-paced environment.  
\- Strong stakeholder management skills to effectively liaise with hiring managers and team members.

Key Responsibilities

\- Manage end\-to\-end IT recruitment for technical and technology positions, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and timelines.  
\- Translate hiring needs and job descriptions into effective sourcing strategies to attract top talent.  
\- Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and databases, maintaining a strong network and pipeline of potential hires.  
\- Screen candidates rigorously based on technical skills, experience, and role fit, ensuring only the best candidates advance.  
\- Conduct initial discussions and coordinate technical and client interviews, acting as the main point of contact for candidates.  
\- Facilitate offer negotiations, manage documentation, and oversee joining formalities to ensure smooth onboarding.  
\- Track and report recruitment metrics, including submissions, interviews, selections, offers, and joiners, to optimize recruitment processes.  
\- Build and maintain a talent pool for frequently hired technology skills, anticipating future hiring needs.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
